title: Hicrete Products Technology
description: hicrete.com Hicrete Products & Technology Co., Ltd. is a Thai construction chemicals manufacturer founded around 2010 in Bangkok, producing epoxy and polyurethane floor coatings, waterproofing systems, concrete repair materials, anti-corrosion coatings and specialized building chemicals. With approximately 30 to 80 employees and estimated revenue of 5 to 20 million dollars, it serves industrial, construction, food, pharmaceutical, oil and marine sectors across Thailand and Southeast Asia. Its product range includes self-leveling epoxy floors, food-grade coatings, carbon fiber reinforcement, cementitious waterproofing and marine-grade anti-corrosion systems. The company operates its own manufacturing facility with in-house R&D for custom chemical formulations. It supplies contractors, architects and facility managers in countries including Thailand, Singapore, Malaysia, Vietnam and Myanmar. Its specialized portfolio addresses demanding environments from clean rooms and food processing.
